final.role: Managed cloud vector database (Milvus-based) with hybrid vector, full-text and JSON search and reranking, for enterprise-scale AI apps
final.evidence: "Full-Spectrum Search: from vector and text to JSON and geospatial, combined with hybrid retrieval, filtering, and reranking"; SaaS/BYOC on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure; "Open Source: Run Milvus in your own environment"; "Production-tested across 10,000+ enterprises"

auditoria.nota: Banco vetorial gerenciado na nuvem (Milvus); desproporcional para um hub pessoal, só o Milvus open source seria alternativa local.
